interface.signature: def convert(head: ListNode, root: TreeNode) -> None:

preconditions.expression: head is None or (head.val is not None and 1 <= head.val <= 10**5)
preconditions.description: The linked list head is either None or a node with a valid integer value between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: root is None or (root.val is not None and 1 <= root.val <= 10**5)
preconditions.description: The tree root is either None or a node with a valid integer value between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= node.val <= 10**5 for node in [head] + [node for node in iter(lambda: head, None) if node] if node is not None)
preconditions.description: All nodes in the linked list (including head) have values between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= node.val <= 10**5 for node in [root] + [node.left, node.right] if node is not None)
preconditions.description: All nodes in the tree (including root) have values between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: len([node for node in iter(lambda: head, None) if node]) == N
preconditions.description: The linked list has exactly N nodes, where N is the input size.

postconditions.expression: all(node.val == head.val if node is root else False for node in [root] + [node.left, node.right] if node is not None)
postconditions.description: The root of the tree is assigned the value of the first node in the linked list.

postconditions.expression: all(node.val == next_node.val for node in [root] + [node.left, node.right] if node is not None for next_node in iter(lambda: head, None) if next_node is not None)
postconditions.description: The tree is constructed such that the value of each node at position i in the tree (root at 0) matches the value of the node at position i in the linked list, where the linked list is traversed in order.

postconditions.expression: all(node.left is None or node.left.val == head.val if node.left is not None else False for node in [root] + [node.left, node.right] if node is not None for head in iter(lambda: head, None) if head is not None)
postconditions.description: The left child of a node at position i in the tree is assigned the value of the node at position 2*i+1 in the linked list, if it exists.

postconditions.expression: all(node.right is None or node.right.val == head.val if node.right is not None else False for node in [root] + [node.left, node.right] if node is not None for head in iter(lambda: head, None) if head is not None)
postconditions.description: The right child of a node at position i in the tree is assigned the value of the node at position 2*i+2 in the linked list, if it exists.

postconditions.expression: all(node.left is None or node.right is None or (node.left.val == head.val and node.right.val == next_node.val) for node in [root] + [node.left, node.right] if node is not None for head in iter(lambda: head, None) if head is not None for next_node in iter(lambda: head.next, None) if next_node is not None)
postconditions.description: The tree is a complete binary tree, meaning every level is fully filled except possibly the last level, which is filled from left to right.
